title: Agents and Chains Module
summary: This module provides the core components for building intelligent agents and orchestrating complex workflows (chains) using language models, tools, memory, and runnables.

nodes.label: AI Agents
nodes.title: AI Agent Framework
nodes.description: Provides a comprehensive framework for building and managing AI agents, offering various agent types, orchestration mechanisms, and tools for integrating language models with external functionalities.

nodes.label: LLM Chains
nodes.title: LLM Chains
nodes.description: Provides building blocks for creating complex sequences of operations, combining LLMs with other components for various tasks.

nodes.label: Runnable Core & Utilities
nodes.title: Runnable Core & Utilities
nodes.description: Defines the foundational `Runnable` interface for composable units of work, enabling serialization, dynamic configuration, and specialized functionalities.

nodes.label: Tools & Output Parsers
nodes.title: Tools and Output Parsers
nodes.description: Provides foundational classes and utilities for defining and interacting with tools, alongside a comprehensive suite of output parsers to structure LLM responses.

nodes.label: Agent Memory & Middleware
nodes.title: Agent Memory and Middleware
nodes.description: Provides memory implementations for conversational AI agents to manage chat history and entities, alongside middleware for controlling and enhancing agent behavior.

groups.label: Core Orchestration
groups.title: Core Orchestration
groups.description: These modules define the primary logic for intelligent agents and structured workflows, enabling complex AI applications.

groups.label: Foundational Components
groups.title: Foundational Building Blocks
groups.description: Provides the basic units of work (runnables) and external interaction capabilities (tools, parsers) that agents and chains utilize.

groups.label: State & Control
groups.title: State Management & Control
groups.description: Offers mechanisms for agents and chains to maintain conversational context, manage long-term memory, and apply behavioral enhancements or restrictions.
